en.t: Emperor Petronius Maximus is stoned to death by an angry mob while fleeing Rome
en.s: Petronius Maximus (c. 397 – 31 May 455) was Roman emperor of the West for two and a half months in 455. A wealthy senator and a prominent aristocrat, he was instrumental in the murders of the Western Roman magister militum, Aëtius, and the Western Roman emperor, Valentinian III.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯逃离罗马时被愤怒的民众用石头砸死
zh.s: 佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯（约397年—455年5月31日）于455年担任西罗马皇帝两个半月。他是富有的元老和显赫贵族，曾参与谋杀西罗马军队统帅埃提乌斯以及西罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世。

en.s: The Battle of Damme was fought on 30 and 31 May 1213 during the 1213–1214 Anglo-French War. An English fleet led by William Longespée, Earl of Salisbury accidentally encountered a large French fleet under the command of Savari de Mauléon in the vicinity of the port of Damme, in Flanders. The French crews were mostly ashore, pillaging the countryside, and the English captured 300 French ships at anchor, and looted and fired a further hundred beached ships.

zh.s: 达姆战役发生于1213年5月30日至31日，是1213—1214年英法战争的一部分。由索尔兹伯里伯爵威廉·朗斯佩率领的英国舰队在法兰德斯达姆港附近意外遇到一支规模庞大的法国舰队。法国船员大多上岸劫掠乡间，英军因此俘获了300艘停泊中的法国船只，并抢掠、焚毁了另外100艘搁浅的船。

en.t: Zhongdu (now Beijing), then under the control of the Jurchen ruler Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, is captured by the Mongols under Genghis Khan, ending the Battle of Zhongdu
en.s: Emperor Xuanzong of Jin (18 April 1163 – 14 January 1224), personal name Wudubu, sinicized names Wanyan Xun and Wanyan Congjia, was the eighth emperor of the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty of China. He was the second Jin emperor to be defeated by the Mongol Empire, and the first after they crossed the Great Wall in 1211 during the Jin campaign.

zh.t: 成吉思汗率领蒙古军攻占金朝统治者金宣宗治下的中都（今北京），中都之战结束
zh.s: 金宣宗（1163年4月18日—1224年1月14日），本名吾睹补，汉名完颜珣、完颜从嘉，是女真统治的中国金朝第八位皇帝。他是第二位被蒙古帝国击败的金朝皇帝，也是1211年蒙古人越过长城后首位被击败的金朝皇帝。

en.s: The Sieges of Zhongdu took place in 1214 and 1215 during the Mongol conquest of the Jin dynasty. Zhongdu, the capital of the Jin dynasty and located in present-day Beijing, was progressively isolated by the forces of the Mongol Empire under Genghis Khan. After earlier Mongol incursions and the relocation of the Jin court to Kaifeng, the city endured prolonged blockade and famine before surrendering in June 1215.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙古征服金朝期间，1214年和1215年发生了中都围城战。成吉思汗率领蒙古帝国军队逐步孤立金朝首都中都（今北京）。此前蒙古军多次入侵，金廷迁往开封；此后，中都遭长期封锁和饥荒，最终于1215年6月投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Kalka River was fought between the Mongol Empire, whose armies were led by Jebe and Subutai, and a coalition of several Rus' principalities, including Kiev and Galicia-Volhynia, and the Cumans under Köten. They were under the joint command of Mstislav the Bold and Mstislav III of Kiev. The battle was fought on May 31, 1223 on the banks of the Kalka River in present-day Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine, and ended in a decisive Mongol victory.

zh.s: 卡尔卡河战役是蒙古帝国与多个罗斯公国组成的联盟之间的战斗，蒙古军由哲别和速不台率领，罗斯一方包括基辅和加利西亚—沃里尼亚等公国，并有钦察人参加。联军由勇者姆斯季斯拉夫和基辅的姆斯季斯拉夫三世共同指挥。1223年5月31日，双方在今乌克兰顿涅茨克州的卡尔卡河畔交战，蒙古军取得决定性胜利。

en.t: Mongols depart Java after the failed Mongol invasion against King Kertanegara of Singhasari
en.s: The Yuan dynasty under Kublai Khan attempted in 1293 to invade Java, an island in modern Indonesia, with 20,000 to 30,000 soldiers. This was intended as a punitive expedition against Kertanegara of Singhasari, who had refused to pay tribute to the Yuan and maimed one of their emissaries. However, in the intervening years between Kertanegara's refusal and the expedition's arrival on Java, Kertanegara had been killed and Singhasari had been usurped by Kediri.

zh.t: 蒙古军结束对新柯尔塔纳王克塔纳格拉的远征，离开爪哇
zh.s: 忽必烈统治下的元朝于1293年派出20,000至30,000名士兵，试图入侵今属印度尼西亚的爪哇岛。这是一次惩罚性远征，目标是新柯尔塔纳王克塔纳格拉；他拒绝向元朝进贡，并伤害了一名元朝使者。然而，在克塔纳格拉拒绝进贡到远征军抵达爪哇之间的几年里，他已被杀害，新柯尔塔纳王国也被谏义里王国篡夺。

en.s: The Battle of Lucka occurred on 31 May 1307 near the village of Lucka. The settlement was first mentioned in 1320, but had already existed for around 700 years before that. Lucka is located in the Altenburger Land district of Thuringia. The battle was fought between the German king Albert I of the Habsburg dynasty and the Margrave Friedrich I of Meissen from the House of Wettin over the disputed ownership of the decedent estates left by Henry III the Illustrious, margrave of Meissen and Lusatia and Landgrave of Thuringia.

zh.s: 吕克战役于1307年5月31日在吕克村附近爆发。吕克最早见于1320年的记载，但在此之前已存在约700年。吕克位于图林根州阿尔滕堡地区。这场战役是哈布斯堡王朝的德国国王阿尔布雷希特一世与韦廷家族的迈森藩侯腓特烈一世之间的冲突，双方争夺的是亨利三世（尊贵者）去世后留下的遗产。亨利曾任迈森和卢萨蒂亚藩侯及图林根伯爵。

en.s: The First Battle of Acentejo took place on the island of Tenerife between the Guanches and an alliance of Spaniards, other Europeans, and associated natives (mostly from other islands), on 31 May 1494, during the Spanish conquest of this island. It resulted in a victory for the Guanches of Tenerife.

zh.s: 第一次阿森特霍战役于1494年5月31日在特内里费岛爆发。交战双方是关切人，以及西班牙人、其他欧洲人和来自其他岛屿的原住民组成的联盟。战役发生在西班牙征服特内里费岛期间，关切人获胜。

en.s: The First Battle of Öland (Swedish: Första slaget vid Ölands norra udde), was part of the Nordic Seven Years War (1563-1570), which broke out as a result of King Erik XIV’s claim for dominion over the Baltic Sea, which "challenged the trade interests of both Denmark and the Hanseatic city of Lubeck".
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 厄兰岛第一次海战（瑞典语：Första slaget vid Ölands norra udde）是北方七年战争（1563—1570年）的一部分。战争起因是国王埃里克十四世声称要统治波罗的海，这“挑战了丹麦和汉萨同盟城市吕贝克双方的贸易利益”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: King Henry III lays the first stone of the Pont Neuf (New Bridge), the oldest bridge of Paris, France
en.s: The Pont Neuf (French pronunciation: [pɔ̃ nœf], "New Bridge") is the oldest standing bridge across the river Seine in Paris, France. It stands by the western (downstream) point of the Île de la Cité, the island in the middle of the river that between 250 and 225 BC was the birthplace of Paris (then known as Lutetia). During the medieval period, the Île was the heart of the city.

zh.t: 法国国王亨利三世为巴黎最古老的桥梁新桥奠基
zh.s: 新桥（法语发音：[pɔ̃ nœf]，意为“新桥”）是横跨法国巴黎塞纳河、现存最古老的桥梁。桥位于西岱岛西端下游一侧。这座河中岛屿是巴黎的发源地，公元前250年至前225年间，巴黎当时称为卢泰西亚。中世纪时期，西岱岛是城市中心。

en.s: The siege of Älvsborg was a siege of the Swedish castle of Älvsborg by a Danish army under the command of Christian IV in the summer of 1612 as part of the Kalmar War. Despite the Swedes' strong defense, their commander Olof Andersson Stråle ultimately surrendered to the Danes' larger fighting forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1612年夏，丹麦军队在克里斯蒂安四世指挥下围攻瑞典的埃尔夫斯堡城堡，这是卡尔马战争的一部分。尽管瑞典守军顽强防守，指挥官奥洛夫·安德松·斯特雷尔最终还是因丹麦军队兵力占优而投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The battle of the Alma (Ukrainian: Битва на Альмі) was a battle that took place on 31 of May, 1628 between a 4,000-strong army of the Zaporozhian Cossacks led by hetman Mykhailo Doroshenko and a colonel Olifer Holub, and the Budjak Horde army of Khan Temir, supported by the Ottoman janissaries. In the course of battle, Zaporozhian Cossacks defeated the army of Khan Temir, which allowed them to lift the siege of Bakhchysarai.

zh.s: 阿尔马河战役于1628年5月31日爆发。扎波罗热哥萨克军队由盖特曼米哈伊洛·多罗申科和上校奥利费尔·霍卢布率领，共约4,000人；对手是帖木儿汗率领的布贾克部落军队，并有奥斯曼禁卫军支援。扎波罗热哥萨克击败了帖木儿汗的军队，得以解除对巴赫奇萨赖的围困。

en.s: The short siege of Worcester (29–31 May 1643) was conducted by a Parliamentary army of about 3,000 under the command of Sir William Waller. They failed to capture the city, which was defended by about 1,700 Royalists under the command of Colonel William Sandys the acting governor, and retreated back to the Parliamentary stronghold of Gloucester.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1643年5月29日至31日，约3,000名议会军在威廉·沃勒爵士率领下围攻伍斯特，但未能攻下这座城市。约1,700名保皇党军队由代理总督威廉·桑兹上校率领守城。议会军最终撤回其据点格洛斯特。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源信息框所列事件的结束日期。

en.s: The capture of Fort Casimir was an intercolonial confrontation between New Sweden and New Netherland in Delaware in 1654. A Swedish force of 1 sloop and 20 to 30 armed soldiers under Johan Risingh attacked the Dutch-controlled Fort Casimir under Sergeant Gerrit Bicker and a garrison of 10–12 men on 31 May 1654. It ended with a Swedish victory, and the fort was captured by Johan Risingh.

zh.s: 1654年5月31日，新瑞典与新尼德兰之间爆发殖民地冲突。一支瑞典部队由约翰·里辛率领，乘坐一艘单桅帆船，带着20至30名武装士兵，袭击了由中士杰里特·比克尔和10至12名守军把守的荷兰堡垒卡西米尔堡。瑞典军获胜，里辛率部攻占了堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Møn, also known as the Battle of Fehmarn, took place 31 May–1 June 1677, as part of the Scanian War. A smaller Swedish squadron under Admiral Erik Sjöblad attempted to sail from Gothenburg to join the main Swedish fleet in the Baltic Sea. It was intercepted by a superior Danish-Norwegian force under Niels Juel and decimated over the course of two days.

zh.s: 蒙岛海战又称费马恩海战，于1677年5月31日至6月1日发生，是斯堪尼亚战争的一部分。埃里克·舍布拉德海军上将率领一支规模较小的瑞典分舰队，试图从哥德堡出发，与波罗的海的瑞典主力舰队会合。尼尔斯·尤尔率领的丹麦—挪威优势兵力拦截了瑞典舰队，并在两天交战中将其重创。

en.s: The Landing at Barcelona was a failed Allied attempt in May 1704 during the War of the Spanish Succession to capture the city of Barcelona from its Spanish pro-Bourbon defenders.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1704年5月，西班牙王位继承战争期间，盟军试图从亲波旁王朝的西班牙守军手中夺取巴塞罗那，但行动失败。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Russo-Turkish War of 1735–1739 between Russia and the Ottoman Empire was caused by the Ottoman Empire's war with Persia and the continuing raids by the Crimean Tatars. The war also represented Russia's ongoing struggle for access to the Black Sea. In 1737, the Habsburg monarchy joined the war on Russia's side, known in historiography as the Austro-Turkish War of 1737–1739.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1735年至1739年，俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国之间爆发俄土战争，起因包括奥斯曼帝国与波斯交战，以及克里米亚鞑靼人持续发动袭击。这场战争也反映了俄罗斯持续争取进入黑海的努力。1737年，哈布斯堡君主国加入俄罗斯一方参战；历史研究通常将这场冲突称为1737年至1739年奥土战争。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Action of 31 May 1762 was a minor naval engagement that took place off the Spanish coast off Cadiz, between a British Royal Naval frigate and a sloop against a Spanish frigate during the recently declared Anglo-Spanish War (1762–63). When the Spanish ship surrendered, it was found that she carried a large cargo of gold and silver that would lead to the greatest amount of prize money awarded to British warships.

zh.s: 1762年5月31日，英国皇家海军的一艘护卫舰和一艘单桅战船在加的斯外海与一艘西班牙护卫舰发生小规模海战。当时英西战争（1762—1763年）刚刚宣战。西班牙舰只投降后，英军发现船上载有大量金银，这笔战利品后来带来英国军舰史上最高额的奖金。

en.s: Fought during the Russo-Turkish War, 1768–1774, this battle took place between 27 and 31 May 1770 at the entrance to the Argolic Gulf in the Ottoman Empire, when a Russian fleet under John Elphinstone engaged a larger Ottoman fleet. Although no ships were lost on either side, Russian casualties were heavy and they had to withdraw. Some sources describe the battle as an Ottoman victory, while others regard it as a Russian success.

zh.s: 这场海战发生于1768—1774年俄土战争期间。1770年5月27日至31日，约翰·埃尔芬斯通率领的俄罗斯舰队在阿尔戈利斯湾入口处与规模更大的奥斯曼舰队交战。双方都没有舰只损失，但俄军伤亡惨重，被迫撤退。一些资料将此战视为奥斯曼胜利，另一些则认为俄罗斯获胜。

en.s: The Copyright Act of 1790 was the first federal copyright act to be instituted in the United States, though most of the states had passed various legislation securing copyrights in the years immediately following the Revolutionary War.
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1790年《版权法》是美国通过的第一部联邦版权法。在美国独立战争后的几年里，大多数州都已通过各自的版权保护法规。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的签署日期。

en.s: The action of 31 May 1796 was a small action during the French Revolutionary Wars in which a Royal Navy squadron under the command of Commodore Horatio Nelson, in the 64-gun third-rate ship of the line HMS Agamemnon, captured a seven-vessel French convoy that was sailing along the coast from Menton to Vado in the Mediterranean. The British succeeded in capturing the entire convoy, with minimal casualties to themselves.

zh.s: 1796年5月31日海战是法国大革命战争期间的一次小规模海战。霍雷肖·纳尔逊准将率领英国皇家海军分舰队，乘坐64门炮的三级战列舰“阿伽门农”号，俘获了一支从芒通沿海驶往瓦多的法国船队，共七艘船。英军成功俘获整支船队，自身伤亡很少。

en.s: The action of 30 May 1798 was a minor naval engagement between a small British squadron and a small French squadron off the coast of Normandy, France during the French Revolutionary Wars. A British blockading force, which had been conducting patrols in the region in the aftermath of the battle of St Marcou earlier in the month, encountered two French vessels attempting to sail unnoticed between Le Havre and Cherbourg-en-Cotentin.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1798年5月30日海战是法国大革命战争期间，英国小型舰队与法国小型舰队在法国诺曼底海岸附近进行的一次小规模海战。此前，英国封锁部队一直在该地区巡逻。本月早些时候圣马尔库夫战役结束后，英军遇到两艘试图避开巡逻、在勒阿弗尔与瑟堡之间航行的法国船只。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The combat of Turbigo was a military engagement of the War of the Second Coalition that took place on 31 May 1800 (11 Prairial VIII) in Turbigo between Austrian and French forces, the latter coming from Piedmont after crossing the Alps.

zh.s: 图尔比戈战斗于1800年5月31日（共和历八年牧草月十一日）在图尔比戈发生，是第二次反法同盟战争中的一场军事交战。奥地利军队与法国军队交战，法军从皮埃蒙特翻越阿尔卑斯山而来。

en.s: The Battle of Diamond Rock (French: Bataille du rocher du Diamant, Spanish: Batalla de la roca del Diamante) took place between 31 May and 2 June 1805 during the War of the Third Coalition, when a Franco-Spanish force dispatched under Captain Julien Cosmao was able to retake Diamond Rock, on the approach to Fort-de-France, from the British forces that had occupied it over a year before.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第三次反法同盟战争期间，法国和西班牙部队于1805年5月31日至6月2日发动行动，由朱利安·科斯毛上校率领，重新夺回马提尼克法兰西堡附近的钻石岩。该岩礁此前已被英国军队占领一年多。
zh.n: 本条记录的是来源信息框所列事件的开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Čegar (Serbian: Битка на Чегру/Bitka na Čegru), also known as the Battle of Kamenica (Бој на Каменици/Boj na Kamenici) took place during the First Serbian Uprising between the Serbian Revolutionaries and Ottoman forces near the Niš Fortress on 31 May 1809. Fought on the Čegar hill situated between the villages of Donji Matejevac and Kamenica near Niš in what is today southeastern Serbia, it ended in an Ottoman victory.

zh.s: 切加尔战役又称卡梅尼察战役，于1809年5月31日在第一次塞尔维亚起义期间爆发。塞尔维亚革命军与奥斯曼军队在尼什要塞附近交战。战场位于东南塞尔维亚的切加尔山，在多尼马泰耶瓦茨村和卡梅尼察村之间。奥斯曼军队获胜。

en.s: The action of 31 May 1809 was a naval skirmish in the Bay of Bengal during the Napoleonic Wars. During the action, East India Company convoy carrying goods worth over £500,000 was attacked and partially captured by the French frigate Caroline. The three East Indiamen that made up the convoy fought against their opponent with their own batteries of cannon but ultimately were less powerful, less manoeuvrable and less trained than their opponent and were defeated one by one; only the smallest of the three escaped.

zh.s: 1809年5月31日海战是拿破仑战争期间在孟加拉湾发生的一次海上交战。法国护卫舰“卡罗琳”号袭击并部分俘获了东印度公司的一支船队，船上货物价值超过50万英镑。船队中的三艘东印度商船用舰炮还击，但在火力、机动性和训练水平上都不及对手，逐一被击败，只有最小的一艘逃脱。

en.s: The Battle of Stralsund took place on 31 May 1809 during the Dano-Swedish War of 1808–1809 and Franco-Swedish War, both part of the larger Napoleonic Wars. It was fought between Prussian freikorps under Ferdinand von Schill and French, Dutch and Dano-Norwegian troops in Stralsund. In a "vicious street battle", Schill's army was defeated and he was killed in action.

zh.s: 施特拉尔松德战役于1809年5月31日爆发，是丹麦—瑞典战争和法瑞战争的一部分，两场战争都属于更广泛的拿破仑战争。普鲁士自由军团由费迪南德·冯·席尔率领，与法国、荷兰和丹麦—挪威军队在施特拉尔松德交战。经过一场“激烈的街巷战”，席尔的军队被击败，他本人也在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Bornos on 31 May 1812, saw a Spanish force led by Francisco Ballesteros attack an Imperial French division under Nicolas François Conroux. Though the Spanish achieved surprise, the outnumbered French soldiers fought back and drove off their assailants. The Spanish suffered losses considerably higher than the French. Bornos is located on Route 342 about 40 miles (64 km) northeast of Jerez de la Frontera.

zh.s: 1812年5月31日，弗朗西斯科·巴列斯特罗斯率领的西班牙军队在博尔诺斯袭击尼古拉·弗朗索瓦·孔鲁率领的法兰西帝国师。西军虽然打了对方一个措手不及，但人数较少的法军奋力反击，将西军击退。西班牙方面的伤亡远高于法国。博尔诺斯位于342号公路沿线，在赫雷斯德拉弗龙特拉东北约40英里（64公里）处。

zh.s: 冷港战役是美国内战期间的一场战斗，于1864年5月31日至6月12日在弗吉尼亚州梅卡尼克斯维尔附近进行，最激烈的战斗发生在6月3日。这是尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将“陆上战役”中的最后几场战斗之一。6月3日，联邦军正面进攻南方邦联将军罗伯特·李所部坚固阵地，造成数千名联邦军士兵死伤。

en.s: The Johnstown Flood, sometimes referred to locally as the Great Flood of 1889, occurred on Friday, May 31, 1889, after the catastrophic failure of the South Fork Dam, located on the south fork of the Little Conemaugh River, 14 miles (23 km) upstream of the town of Johnstown, Pennsylvania, United States. The dam ruptured after several days of extremely heavy rainfall, releasing 14.55 million cubic meters of water.

zh.s: 约翰斯敦洪灾有时在当地称为1889年大洪水，于1889年5月31日星期五发生。宾夕法尼亚州约翰斯敦上游14英里（23公里）处的小康内莫河南支水坝在连续数日强降雨后溃决，释放出1455万立方米洪水。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Serbia on 31 May 1893. They were held following a coup d'état by King Alexander in April, which removed the Liberal government which had remained in power following the March 1893 elections. The People's Radical Party won a large majority.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚于1893年5月31日举行议会选举。此前，国王亚历山大在4月发动政变，推翻了自同年3月选举后一直执政的自由党政府。人民激进党赢得大幅多数。

en.s: The Treaty of Vereeniging was a peace treaty, signed on 31 May 1902, that ended the Second Boer War between the South African Republic and the Orange Free State on the one side, and the United Kingdom on the other. This settlement provided for the end of hostilities and eventual self-government to the Transvaal (South African Republic) and the Orange Free State as British colonies.

zh.s: 弗里尼欣和约于1902年5月31日签署，结束了第二次布尔战争。交战双方一边是南非共和国和奥兰治自由邦，另一边是英国。条约结束了敌对行动，并规定德兰士瓦（南非共和国）和奥兰治自由邦最终成为英国殖民地并实行自治。

en.s: The 1903 German football championship final decided the winner of the 1903 German football championship, the 1st edition of the German football championship, a knockout football cup competition contested by the regional league winners to determine the national champions. The match was played on 31 May 1903 at the Exerzierweide in Altona. VfB Leipzig won the match 7–2 against DFC Prag to become the first national champions in German football history.

zh.s: 1903年德国足球锦标赛决赛决出了首届德国足球锦标赛冠军。这项杯赛由各地区联赛冠军参加，通过淘汰赛决出全国冠军。比赛于1903年5月31日在阿尔托纳的埃克塞齐尔维德球场举行。莱比锡足球俱乐部以7比2击败布拉格DFC，成为德国足球历史上首支全国冠军球队。

en.s: The Union of South Africa (Dutch: Unie van Zuid-Afrika; Afrikaans: Unie van Suid-Afrika, ) was a British Dominion and, later, a Commonwealth realm in southern Africa from 1910 to 1961. It was the historical predecessor to the present-day Republic of South Africa. It came into existence on 31 May 1910 with the unification of the Cape, Natal, Transvaal, and Orange River colonies.

zh.t: 《南非法案》生效，南非联邦成立
zh.s: 南非联邦（荷兰语：Unie van Zuid-Afrika；南非语：Unie van Suid-Afrika）曾是英国自治领，后来成为英联邦王国，存在于1910年至1961年。它是现今南非共和国的历史前身。1910年5月31日，开普、纳塔尔、德兰士瓦和奥兰治河四个殖民地合并，南非联邦由此成立。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 31 May 1913. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives, and 18 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Australian Labor Party led by Prime Minister Andrew Fisher was defeated by the opposition Commonwealth Liberal Party led by Joseph Cook, by a single seat. The new government also held a minority of seats in the Senate. The government would lose the double dissolution 15 months later at the 1914 election. The 1913 election was held in conjunction with six referendum questions, none of which was carried.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1913年5月31日举行联邦选举。众议院75个席位和参议院36个席位中的18席改选。时任总理安德鲁·费舍尔领导的澳大利亚工党以一席之差败给由约瑟夫·库克领导的反对党联邦自由党。新政府在参议院也未获多数席位。15个月后，政府在1914年的双重解散选举中落败。此次选举还同时举行了六项公投，均未获通过。

en.s: The Battle of Jutland took place in the North Sea between the German High Seas Fleet and British Grand Fleet on the afternoon and evening of 31 May 1916, continuing sporadically through the night into the early hours of 1 June. The battle was the only direct engagement between the two fleets throughout World War I.

zh.s: 1916年5月31日下午和夜间，德国公海舰队与英国大舰队在北海展开日德兰海战；零星交战持续至6月1日凌晨。这是第一次世界大战期间两支舰队之间唯一一次直接交锋。

en.s: The Battle of Jutland (German: Skagerrakschlacht, lit. 'Battle of the Skagerrak') was a naval battle between Britain's Royal Navy Grand Fleet, under Admiral Sir John Jellicoe, and the Imperial German Navy's High Seas Fleet, under Vice-Admiral Reinhard Scheer, during the First World War. The battle unfolded in extensive manoeuvring and three main engagements from 31 May to 1 June 1916, off the North Sea coast of Denmark's Jutland Peninsula.
en.n: World War I: Battle of Jutland: The British Grand Fleet engages the High Seas Fleet in the largest naval battle of the war, which proves indecisive.

zh.s: 日德兰海战（德语：Skagerrakschlacht，意为“斯卡格拉克海峡之战”）是第一次世界大战期间英国皇家海军大舰队与德国帝国海军公海舰队之间的海战。英国舰队由约翰·杰利科海军上将指挥，德国舰队由莱因哈德·舍尔海军中将指挥。1916年5月31日至6月1日，双方在丹麦日德兰半岛北海沿岸附近进行了多轮机动和三场主要交战。

en.s: The Battle of Skra-di-Legen was a two-day battle which took place at the Skra fortified position, located northeast of Mount Paiko, which is north-west of Thessaloniki, on May 29–30, 1918, on the Macedonian front of World War I. The battle was the first large-scale employment on the front of Greek troops of the National Defense Army Corps (Greece, united after the National Schism, had joined the war in summer 1917), and resulted in the elimination of a whole enemy regiment (the 49th) and the capture of the heavily fortified Bulgarian positions.

en.s: The Battle of Bystrzyk happened on May 31, 1920, near the village of Bystryk near Kiev. It was a part of the ill-fated offensive of the Budyonny's Cavalry Army assault on the Polish-Ukrainian troops defending Kiev after their offensive on Kiev a month earlier, during the Polish-Bolshevik War. The Bolshevik assault started on May 26, with the aim of cutting off the Polish 2nd and 3rd Armies and encircling them in a huge pocket. One of the assaulting divisions of the Cavalry Army, the Soviet 11th Cavalry Division, managed to break the front line between the two Polish armies and assaulted a fortified village of Bystrzyk, defended only by a single infantry company of the Polish 50th Kresy Rifles Regiment.

zh.s: 比斯特里克战役于1920年5月31日在基辅附近的比斯特里克村一带发生，是布琼尼骑兵集团军进攻波兰和乌克兰军队的一部分。当时波兰和乌克兰军队在一个月前进攻基辅后负责守城。这场进攻是波苏战争期间的一次失利行动。布尔什维克军队于5月26日发动攻势，试图切断波兰第2、第3集团军的联系并将其包围。苏联第11骑兵师突破了两支波兰军队之间的防线，随后进攻设防的比斯特里克村。村庄仅由波兰第50克雷西步枪团的一个步兵连防守。

en.t: The Tanggu Truce, sometimes called the , was a ceasefire that was signed between military forces of the Republic of China and the Empire of Japan in Tanggu, Tianjin, on May 31, 1933
en.s: The Tanggu Truce, sometimes called the Tangku Truce (Japanese: 塘沽協定, Hepburn: Tōko kyōtei; traditional Chinese: 塘沽協定; simplified Chinese: 塘沽协定; pinyin: Tánggū Xiédìng), was a ceasefire that was signed between military forces of the Republic of China and the Empire of Japan in Tanggu, Tianjin, on May 31, 1933. It ended the Japanese invasion of Manchuria, which had begun in September 1931.

zh.s: 塘沽协定（又称塘沽停战协定；日语：塘沽協定，Tōko kyōtei；繁体中文：塘沽協定；简体中文：塘沽协定；拼音：Tánggū Xiédìng）于1933年5月31日在天津塘沽签署，是中华民国与日本帝国军方之间的停战协定。协定结束了1931年9月开始的日本侵占满洲行动。

en.s: An earthquake occurred on 31 May 1935 between 2:30 am and 3:40 am at Quetta, Baluchistan Agency (now part of Pakistan), close to the border with southern Afghanistan. en.t: The Uniform Code of Military Justice takes effect as the legal system of the United States Armed Forces
en.s: The Uniform Code of Military Justice (UCMJ) is the foundation of the system of military justice of the armed forces of the United States. The UCMJ was established by the United States Congress in accordance with their constitutional authority, per Article I Section 8 of the U.S. Constitution, which provides that "The Congress shall have Power . . . to make Rules for the Government and Regulation of the land and naval forces" of the United States.

en.s: The Constitution of 1961 (formally the Republic of South Africa Constitution Act, 1961) was the fundamental law of South Africa for two decades. Under the terms of the constitution South Africa ceased to be a Commonwealth realm and became a republic, until rejoining the Commonwealth of Nations in 1994. Legally, the Union of South Africa, which had existed since 1910, came to an end and was re-established as the "Republic of South Africa".
en.n: The South African Constitution of 1961 becomes effective, thus creating the Republic of South Africa, which remains outside the Commonwealth of Nations until 1 June 1994, when South Africa is returned to Commonwealth membership.

zh.s: 《1961年宪法》（正式名称为《1961年南非共和国宪法法案》）是南非二十年来的根本法。根据宪法，南非结束英联邦王国地位，成为共和国，直到1994年重新加入英联邦。1910年成立的南非联邦在法律上终结，并以“南非共和国”之名重新建立。
zh.n: 1961年《南非宪法》生效，南非共和国由此成立。南非此后一直未加入英联邦，直到1994年6月1日重新加入。

en.s: The 1970 Ancash earthquake (also known as the Great Peruvian earthquake) occurred on 31 May off the coast of Peru in the Pacific Ocean at 15:23:29 local time. Due to the large amounts of snow and ice included in the landslide that caused an estimated 66,794–70,000 fatalities, it is also considered to be the world's deadliest avalanche.

en.s: The 1973 Svenska Cupen final took place on 31 May 1973 at Stadsparksvallen in Jönköping. The match was contested by Allsvenskan sides Malmö FF and Åtvidabergs FF. The two clubs had faced each other just two years earlier in the 1971 Final . Åtvidaberg played their fourth final in total, Malmö FF played their ninth final in total. Malmö FF won their seventh title with a 7–0 victory.

zh.s: 1973年瑞典杯决赛于1973年5月31日在延雪平的城市公园球场举行，对阵双方是瑞典超级联赛球队马尔默和奥特维达贝里。两队曾在两年前的1971年决赛中交手。奥特维达贝里第四次闯入决赛，马尔默则是第九次。马尔默以7比0获胜，赢得队史第七座瑞典杯。

en.s: The Islamist uprising in Syria comprised a series of protests, assassinations, bombings, and armed revolts led by Sunni Islamists, mainly members of the Fighting Vanguard and, after 1979, the Muslim Brotherhood, from 1976 until 1982. The uprising aimed to establish an Islamic republic in Syria by overthrowing the neo-Ba'athist government, in what was described by the Ba'ath Party as a "long campaign of terror".

zh.t: 叙利亚伊斯兰主义起义
zh.s: 叙利亚伊斯兰主义起义是1976年至1982年间由逊尼派伊斯兰主义者发动的一系列抗议、暗杀、爆炸和武装叛乱，参与者主要来自战斗先锋队，1979年后则以穆斯林兄弟会成员为主。起义旨在推翻新复兴党政府，在叙利亚建立伊斯兰共和国；复兴党称之为“一场漫长的恐怖活动”。

en.t: May 1977 Australian Labor Party leadership spill
en.s: A leadership spill of the Australian Labor Party (ALP), then the opposition party in the Parliament of Australia, was held on 31 May 1977. Former Treasurer Bill Hayden unsuccessfully challenged Labor leader Gough Whitlam. Whitlam was narrowly re-elected by 32 votes to 30 (the smallest possible majority) leading him to later refer to many in his caucus as 'out of touch'.

zh.s: 澳大利亚工党于1977年5月31日举行党魁投票。当时该党是澳大利亚议会的反对党。前财政部长比尔·海登挑战党魁高夫·惠特拉姆，但未能胜出。惠特拉姆以32票对30票险胜，领先两票，这是可能的最小多数。他后来称党团中许多人“脱离现实”。

en.s: There was a by-election for the United Kingdom House of Commons in Hamilton on Wednesday 31 May 1978. It was caused by the death of the incumbent Labour Party Member of Parliament Alex Wilson on 23 March of that year. The by-election was the last in the UK to date not held on a Thursday. This was because the opening game of the 1978 FIFA World Cup was on Thursday 1 June. The Labour candidate was George Robertson, who defeated a strong SNP candidate Margo MacDonald, with an increased majority.

zh.s: 英国下议院汉密尔顿选区于1978年5月31日（星期三）举行补选。此次补选因在任工党议员亚历克斯·威尔逊于当年3月23日去世而举行。这是英国迄今最后一次在星期四以外的日期举行补选，因为1978年世界杯的揭幕战安排在6月1日星期四。工党候选人乔治·罗伯逊击败了实力强劲的苏格兰民族党候选人马戈·麦克唐纳，扩大了多数优势。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in 1980, to elect members to the Bihar Legislative Assembly. After the elections, the Congress emerged as the largest party, and Jagannath Mishra was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar. Later, Chandrashekhar Singh became the Chief Minister from 14 August 1983 to 12 March 1985.

zh.s: 1980年举行比哈尔邦议会选举，选出比哈尔邦议会议员。选举后，国大党成为议会第一大党，贾甘纳特·米什拉宣誓就任比哈尔邦首席部长。此后，钱德拉谢卡尔·辛格于1983年8月14日至1985年3月12日担任首席部长。

en.s: Elections to the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly were held in May 1980, to elect members of the 200 constituencies in Rajasthan, India. The Indian National Congress (I) won a majority of seats as well as the popular vote, and its leader, Jagannath Pahadia was appointed as the Chief Minister of Rajasthan. After the passing of The Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 1976, Rajasthan's Legislative Assembly was assigned 200 constituencies.

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Uttar Pradesh in May 1980. The Indian National Congress remained the largest party, winning 309 of the 425 seats. The elections were held after President Neelam Sanjiva Reddy ordered the imposition of President's rule in the state on the advice of the Fourth Indira Gandhi ministry, which acted on basis that the victory of the Indian National Congress in the 1980 Indian general election proved that the state government no longer reflected the will of the pepule.

zh.s: 1980年5月，北方邦举行立法议会选举。印度国民大会党仍是最大政党，赢得425个席位中的309席。此前，尼拉姆·桑吉瓦·雷迪总统根据英迪拉·甘地第四届内阁的建议，在该邦实施总统管治；其理由是，印度国民大会党在1980年全国大选中获胜，表明邦政府已不能代表民众意愿。

en.s: The Skirmish at Top Malo House was fought on 31 May 1982 during the Falklands War, between 1st section Argentine Special Forces from 602 Commando Company and a patrol formed from staff and students of the British Mountain and Arctic Warfare Cadre, a training unit of the Royal Marines placed under Operational Control of 3 Commando Brigade for Operation Corporate.

zh.s: 托普马洛庄园交火发生于1982年5月31日福克兰群岛战争期间。交战双方是阿根廷特种部队第602突击队连的第一分队，以及英国皇家海军陆战队山地与北极作战训练队的一支巡逻队。该训练队的教官和学员当时受福克兰群岛战争中英国第3突击旅的作战指挥。

en.s: The 1984 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1983–84 DFB-Pokal, the 41st season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 31 May 1984 at the Waldstadion in Frankfurt, the most recent DFB-Pokal final not to be played at the Olympiastadion in West Berlin (now Berlin). Bayern Munich won the match 7–6 on penalties against Borussia Mönchengladbach, following a 1–1 draw after extra time, to claim their seventh cup title.

zh.s: 1984年德国足协杯决赛决出了1983—84赛季德国足协杯冠军。决赛于1984年5月31日在法兰克福森林球场举行，这是最近一次没有在柏林奥林匹克体育场（当时位于西柏林）举行的德国足协杯决赛。拜仁慕尼黑在加时赛后以1比1战平门兴格拉德巴赫，随后在点球大战中以7比6获胜，赢得队史第七座德国杯。

en.s: The 1985 United States – Canada tornado outbreak, referred to as the Barrie tornado outbreak in Canada, was a major tornado outbreak that occurred in Ohio, Pennsylvania, New York, and Ontario, on May 31, 1985. Forty-four tornadoes were counted including 14 in Ontario, Canada. It is the largest and most intense tornado outbreak ever to hit this region, and the worst tornado outbreak in Pennsylvania history in terms of deaths and destruction.

zh.t: 1985年美国—加拿大龙卷风暴发事件
zh.s: 1985年5月31日，俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州、纽约州和加拿大安大略省发生大规模龙卷风暴发事件。在加拿大，这次事件被称为巴里龙卷风灾害。共记录到44场龙卷风，其中14场发生在安大略省。这是该地区有记录以来规模最大、强度最高的龙卷风暴发事件，也是宾夕法尼亚州死亡和破坏最严重的一次。

en.s: Chai Wan (Chinese: 柴灣) is the eastern terminus of the MTR Island line on Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong. It is the only station on the Island line that is elevated. The station is located at the junction of Chai Wan Road and Island Eastern Corridor, and serves Siu Sai Wan and Chai Wan, a primarily residential and industrial town.

zh.s: 柴湾（中文：柴灣）是香港港岛线东端总站，也是港岛线唯一的高架车站。车站位于柴湾道与东区走廊交界处，服务小西湾和柴湾一带以住宅和工业区为主的社区。

en.s: The siege of Dubrovnik (Serbo-Croatian: opsada Dubrovnika, опсада Дубровника) was a military campaign fought between the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) and Croatian forces defending the city of Dubrovnik and its surroundings during the Croatian War of Independence. The JNA started its advance on 1 October 1991, and by late October, it had captured virtually all the land between the Pelješac and Prevlaka peninsulas on the coast of the Adriatic Sea, with the exception of Dubrovnik itself.

en.t: The Confederation Bridge opens, linking Prince Edward Island with mainland New Brunswick
en.s: The Confederation Bridge (French: Pont de la Confédération) is a box girder bridge carrying the Trans-Canada Highway across the Abegweit Passage of the Northumberland Strait, linking the province of Prince Edward Island with the mainland province of New Brunswick. Opened on May 31, 1997, the 12.9-kilometre (42,000 ft; 8.0 mi) bridge is Canada's longest bridge and the world's longest bridge over ice-covered water.

zh.s: 联邦大桥是一座箱梁桥，承载横贯加拿大公路，跨越诺森伯兰海峡的阿贝韦特水道，连接爱德华王子岛和新不伦瑞克省大陆部分。大桥于1997年5月31日开放，全长12.9公里（42,000英尺；8.0英里），是加拿大最长的桥，也是世界上最长的冰覆水域桥梁。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 31 May 1998, with a second round on 21 June. Although Horacio Serpa of the Liberal Party received the most votes in the first round, the result was a victory for Andrés Pastrana Arango of the Great Alliance for Change, who received 51.9% of the vote in the run-off.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚于1998年5月31日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于6月21日举行。自由党候选人奥拉西奥·塞尔帕在首轮中得票最多，但最终由变革大联盟的安德烈斯·帕斯特拉纳·阿朗戈胜出，他在决选中获得51.9%的选票。

en.s: The 2003 Progressive Conservative leadership election was held on May 31, 2003 to elect a leader of the Progressive Conservative Party of Canada. Peter MacKay was elected as leader to replace former Prime Minister Joe Clark, who had retired as party leader. In the end, five candidates emerged as challengers for the leadership by the convention date. Two other candidates had participated in the race but both withdrew as contestants before the vote. Quebec Member of Parliament (MP) André Bachand withdrew his candidacy from the race due to financial concerns and backed Peter MacKay.

en.t: 2008 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 2008 Portuguese Social Democratic Party leadership election was held on 31 May 2008. This was a snap leadership election following the surprise resignation of then party leader Luís Filipe Menezes, elected just seven months before in September 2007, from the party's leadership. Menezes was facing heavy internal criticism for his leadership and opposition strategy but, nonetheless, his resignation surprised party members and structures.

en.s: Six civilian ships of the Gaza Freedom Flotilla were raided by Israel on 31 May 2010 in international waters in the Mediterranean Sea. en.s: The 2013 El Reno tornado was a very large and intense EF3 tornado that occurred over rural areas of Central Oklahoma during the early evening of May 31, 2013. The widest tornado in recorded history, it was part of a larger weather system that produced dozens of tornadoes over the preceding days. The tornado initially touched down at 6:03 p.m. Central Daylight Time (2303 UTC) about 8.3 miles (13.4 km) west-southwest of El Reno, rapidly growing in size and becoming more violent as it tracked through central portions of Canadian County.

zh.s: 2013年5月31日傍晚，一场范围很大、强度达到EF3级的龙卷风袭击俄克拉何马州中部乡村地区。它是有记录以来宽度最大的龙卷风，也是此前数日形成数十场龙卷风的大型天气系统的一部分。龙卷风于中部夏令时间下午6时03分在埃尔雷诺以西偏南约8.3英里（13.4公里）处着陆，随后迅速扩大并增强，经过加拿大县中部地区。

en.s: The Western al-Hasakah offensive, dubbed Operation Commander Rûbar Qamishlo by the Kurds, was a military operation during May 2015 in the Al-Hasakah Governorate, during the Syrian Civil War, conducted by Kurdish YPG and allied forces against the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant. en.s: The Venetian regional election of 2015 took place in Veneto on 31 May 2015, as part of a big round of regional elections in Italy. Venetian voters elected their President and their Regional Council, whose members had been reduced to 51, including the President. Luca Zaia, incumbent President (elected in 2010 with 60.2% of the vote) and leading member of Liga Veneta–Lega Nord (LV–LN), was re-elected by a reduced majority, due to a split occurred within his party in the run-up of the election, but, despite this, his victory over Alessandra Moretti of the Democratic Party (PD), who fared quite badly, was still a landslide: 50.1% to 22.7%.

zh.s: 威尼托大区于2015年5月31日举行大区选举，是意大利当年一轮大区选举的一部分。选民选出大区主席和大区议会议员，议员人数已减至51人，其中包括主席。时任主席卢卡·扎亚曾在2010年以60.2%的得票率当选，这次代表北方联盟（Liga Veneta–Lega Nord）再次参选并以较低优势连任。尽管党内分裂影响了结果，他仍以50.1%对22.7%的得票率大胜民主党候选人亚历山德拉·莫雷蒂。

en.s: On 31 May 2017, a truck bomb exploded at a crowded intersection in Kabul, Afghanistan, near the German embassy at about 08:25 local time (03:55 GMT) during rush hour, killing over 150 and injuring 413, mostly civilians, and damaging several buildings in the embassy. The attack was the deadliest terror attack to take place in Kabul. The diplomatic quarter—in which the attack took place—is one of the most heavily fortified areas in the city, with three-meter-high (10 ft) blast walls, and access requiring passing through several checkpoints. The explosion created a crater about 4.5 meters (15 ft) wide and 3 meters (10 ft) deep.

zh.s: 2017年5月31日当地时间上午约8时25分（格林尼治标准时间3时55分），一辆卡车炸弹在阿富汗喀布尔一处繁忙路口爆炸，地点靠近德国大使馆。爆炸造成150多人死亡、413人受伤，死伤者大多是平民，大使馆内多栋建筑也受损。这是喀布尔发生过的最致命恐怖袭击。袭击地点位于外交区，是全市防卫最严密的区域之一，周围设有三米高（10英尺）的防爆墙，进入该区域须经过多个检查站。爆炸炸出一个约4.5米（15英尺）宽、3米（10英尺）深的弹坑。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Somaliland on 31 May 2021, alongside local district elections. zh.s: 2025年泰国联赛杯决赛决出了2024—25赛季泰国联赛杯冠军，这是泰国第二个时期的第15届杯赛。决赛于2025年5月31日在泰国巴吞他尼府的BG体育场举行，由南奔勇士对阵武里南联。南奔勇士来自泰国北部的南奔府，武里南联则来自伊善地区南部的武里南府。

en.s: The 2025 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2024–25 UEFA Champions League, the 70th season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 33rd season since it was renamed from the European Champion Clubs' Cup to the UEFA Champions League. It was held at the Allianz Arena in Munich, Germany, on 31 May 2025, between French club Paris Saint-Germain and Italian club Inter Milan.

zh.s: 2025年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2024—25赛季欧冠的最后一场比赛，也是欧足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部赛事第70个赛季的决赛。自赛事由欧洲冠军俱乐部杯更名为欧洲冠军联赛以来，这是第33个赛季的决赛。比赛于2025年5月31日在德国慕尼黑安联球场举行，对阵双方是法国巴黎圣日耳曼和意大利国际米兰。

zh.s: UFC ESPN格斗之夜：格莫特对克莱因，也称UFC ESPN 68或UFC Vegas 107，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2025年5月31日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex举行。恩特普赖斯位于拉斯维加斯谷地。

en.s: The 2025 All-Ireland Under-20 Hurling Championship final was a hurling match that was played on 31 May to determine the winners of the 2025 All-Ireland Under-20 Hurling Championship, the 62nd season of the All-Ireland Under-20 Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion teams of Leinster and Munster. The final was contested by Tipperary of Munster and Kilkenny of Leinster and was shown live on TG4.

zh.t: 2025年全爱尔兰20岁以下曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2025年全爱尔兰20岁以下曲棍球锦标赛决赛于5月31日举行，决出2025年该项锦标赛冠军。这是全爱尔兰20岁以下锦标赛第62届，由盖尔运动协会主办，参赛队伍是伦斯特和蒙斯特的冠军球队。决赛由蒙斯特的蒂珀雷里对阵伦斯特的基尔肯尼，并通过TG4电视台直播。

en.s: On 31 May 2026, a major explosion occurred at a building storing explosives used for mining in Namhkam Township, Shan State, Myanmar. The explosion occurred in territory controlled by the Ta'ang National Liberation Army (TNLA), one of the rebel groups fighting in the country's ongoing civil war. The explosion largely leveled Kaung Tat village, killing more than 46 people and injuring more than 112 people.

zh.s: 2026年5月31日，缅甸掸邦南坎镇一栋存放采矿用炸药的建筑发生严重爆炸。事发地由德昂民族解放军控制，该组织是缅甸内战中的反政府武装之一。爆炸几乎夷平了光达村，造成46人以上死亡、112人以上受伤。
